notes.title: 🏥 Age-65 Insurance Cliff
notes.body: Medicare does not travel. Shop GeoBlue Xplorer Premier or Cigna Global Platinum 6 months before departure. The age-65 premium is roughly double the age-56 premium — combined coverage runs ~$1,550/month including a MEDEVAC rider, and is the single largest non-haul cost in the budget.

notes.title: 🐕 NZ + AU Dog Quarantine
notes.body: Combined ~$6,700 lands in M20–M21. Start the rabies titer blood draw in Tonga (M16) — Australia requires 180 days minimum between titer and arrival. Skip this and the dog flies home alone, or you skip both countries.

notes.title: 💡 Year 3 Is The Cheapest
notes.body: Sri Lanka, Philippines, India, and the Maldives pull Year 3's monthly average below Years 1 and 2 by ~$400/mo. Plan for the Indian Ocean to be where you rebuild any reserve drawn down by Pacific dockage.

notes.title: 🏗️ Three Haul-Outs, Three Strategies
notes.body: Ushuaia (M10) — cheapest yard, pre-Horn imperative. Cairns / Whitsundays (M21) — expensive but the only safe option before Asia. Richards Bay or Durban (M33) — best quality yards on the route. Avoid hauling in French Polynesia at all costs.

notes.title: ⚠️ Cape Horn Buffer — Non-Negotiable
notes.body: The $2,000 in M11 covers weather-window holds, channel beacon damage, sail repair, or a forced retreat. Skipping this buffer is the single most common rookie planning error for southern-route circumnavigators.

notes.title: 🔴 East Africa Routing
notes.body: Never route through the Gulf of Aden. Hug the East African coast south — Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique — and round at Durban. Time the Cape Town departure for April/May before Southern Ocean winter. The Agulhas Current is fast and rough; wait for your window.

notes.title: 🐾 Dog Boarding Abroad
notes.body: Cruiser Facebook groups are the best resource. Book 2+ weeks ahead. Europe and Japan are easy; SE Asia and East Africa require legwork. South American marinas often have staff who'll watch the dog for cash. Bring health records to every booking.

notes.title: 📋 $30K Emergency Reserve
notes.body: Hold $30,000 entirely outside the monthly operating budget. Three years of bluewater sailing will stress every system multiple times — watermaker, sails, engines, dinghy, electronics. The chance of a major unplanned expense over 36 months is effectively 100%.

months.label: Jun
months.summary: Departure month. Peak Med season — dockage is expensive but the cruising is unbeatable. First home trip uses up most of the discretionary budget.

months.label: Jul
months.summary: Adriatic coast in high season. Bays and historic harbors. Croatian marina prices ease somewhat compared to Spain.

months.label: Aug
months.summary: Greek cruising at peak. Stern-to anchoring at islands, archeological day trips. Meltemi winds add fuel costs.

months.label: Sep
months.summary: Turkey is the sweet spot of the eastern Med — full-service marinas at half the EU price. Second home trip.

months.label: Oct
months.summary: Reposition west and provision for the Atlantic crossing. Las Palmas is the global pre-crossing waypoint — every cruiser stops here.

months.label: Nov
months.summary: The classic trade-wind milk run. ~3,000 nm. Stop in Cape Verde for fuel and fresh produce. Doldrums band requires motoring.

lines.name: Underway provisioning
lines.note: fresh in Cape Verde, dry stores last

months.label: Dec
months.summary: Atlantic landfall. Salvador is the cultural capital. Holiday season — third home trip.

months.label: Jan
months.summary: Rio in summer. Glória marina or Ilha Grande anchorages. Brazilian summer extends through February.

lines.name: Marina — Glória or Rio yacht clubs

months.label: Feb
months.summary: Río de la Plata transit. Buenos Aires is a great urban stop — affordable beef, tango, and steakhouses.

months.label: Mar
months.summary: Haul-out #1 in the southernmost yard on earth. Refit before Drake Passage. Cheapest of the three haul-outs.

lines.name: Cape Horn safety gear & rigging check

months.label: Apr
months.summary: The legendary rounding. Then weeks of channel cruising through one of the world's last great wildernesses. Fourth home trip — long flights.

lines.name: Cape Horn emergency reserve
lines.note: weather delays · channel repair · sail damage

months.label: May
months.location: Chile North — Puerto Montt to Valparaíso
months.summary: Northbound in the Chilean autumn. Provision and stage for the leap across the Pacific to Easter Island.

months.label: Jun
months.summary: 1,600 nm leap to the most remote inhabited island on earth. Anchor off Hanga Roa with the moai in view. Diesel is gold here.

months.label: Jul
months.region: Nuku Hiva · Hiva Oa · Fatu Hiva
months.summary: Landfall at Hiva Oa is one of cruising's great moments. FP imposes a cruising bond. Fifth home trip via Tahiti.

months.label: Aug
months.summary: Postcard French Polynesia. Mooring fields in Bora Bora are mandatory and expensive. Diving and snorkeling at world-class sites.

months.label: Sep
months.summary: Tonga whale season. CRITICAL: draw rabies titer blood here for NZ/AU quarantine in M20–M21.

months.label: Oct
months.summary: Pago Pago is the cheap-fuel waypoint of the South Pacific. Sixth home trip via Hawai'i.

months.label: Nov
months.summary: Fiji has the South Pacific's best diving. Yasawas and Lau group are remote and pristine. Sevusevu kava ceremonies at every village.

months.label: Dec
months.summary: Tanna's active Mount Yasur volcano — sail up at sunset, watch lava bombs at the rim. Holiday season aboard.

months.label: Jan
months.summary: Strict biosecurity. Dog enters 10-day quarantine. Seventh home trip via Auckland. NZ marina rates are first-world.

months.label: Feb
months.summary: Haul-out #2 in Cairns. Dog enters 10-day AU quarantine. Most expensive single month of the entire trip.

months.label: Mar
months.summary: Sail across the top of Australia via Torres Strait. Darwin is the staging port for Indonesia. Kakadu day trip from Darwin.

lines.name: AU port fees + Indonesia CAIT prep

months.label: Apr
months.summary: Indonesia is fantastic value. Komodo dragons, Bali culture. CAIT permit gets you 3 months.

months.label: May
months.summary: Raja Ampat — the global epicenter of marine biodiversity. Eighth home trip via Jakarta or Bali.

lines.name: Indonesia port fees + Raja Ampat permit

months.label: Jun
months.summary: Palawan limestone karsts and turquoise water. Cheapest cruising of the entire trip starts here.

lines.name: El Nido island hopping, Coron wrecks

months.label: Jul
months.summary: Transit north to Taiwan staging for Japan. Ninth home trip via Manila or Taipei.

months.label: Aug
months.summary: Cruise the Ryukyu chain north into Kyushu. Japanese cruising culture is extremely welcoming. Diesel and marinas pricier than Asia.

lines.name: Food, vet, Japan import cert + titer

months.label: Sep
months.summary: Seto Inland Sea is a hidden gem. Final position in Tokyo Bay before the long leap to Sri Lanka. Tenth home trip.

months.label: Oct
months.summary: Galle fort marina is the iconic Indian Ocean waypoint. Cheapest month of the entire trip — provisioning and dining are pennies.

months.label: Nov
months.summary: Atoll cruising in the Indian Ocean. Cruising permit covers the whole archipelago. Diving and snorkeling everywhere.

months.label: Dec
months.summary: India customs are notoriously complex — hire an agent. Backwaters of Kerala. Eleventh home trip via Mumbai or Delhi. Holiday season.

months.label: Jan
months.summary: Granite islands, giant tortoises, and crystalline anchorages. The transition zone between Indian Ocean and East Africa.

months.label: Feb
months.location: East Africa — Kenya to South Africa
months.region: Mombasa · Dar es Salaam · Richards Bay haul-out #3
months.summary: Sail down the East African coast — Kenya, Tanzania, Mozambique — and haul in Richards Bay or Durban. Best yards of the trip. Hug the coast; the Agulhas Current is fierce.

lines.name: Safari day trip, Stone Town tour

months.label: Mar
months.region: Royal Cape YC · V&A Waterfront · Cape of Good Hope
months.summary: Cape Town is the great waypoint of the southern circuit. Provision for the final ocean leg. Twelfth home trip — longest routing of the year.

months.label: Apr
months.summary: The closing ocean. Hop St. Helena and Ascension for fuel and a swim. Trade winds carry you back toward South America.

months.label: May
months.summary: Landfall in Barbados closes the loop. Sail up the chain to the BVI. Friends and family fly in to celebrate three years of sailing around the world.
